title: Specific Agent Tools
summary: This module provides a comprehensive collection of specialized tools for agents, including functionalities for web scraping, diverse data querying, file and document management, AWS Bedrock services, AI-powered vision and OCR, Contextual AI integrations, Patronus evaluation, and various platform-specific automation and integrations.

nodes.label: Web Scraping & Search
nodes.title: Web Scraping and Search Tools
nodes.description: Tools for extracting and searching information from the web using various services like Brave, Firecrawl, Jina, Oxylabs, Scrapegraph, Serper, Serply, and Tavily.

nodes.label: Web Automation
nodes.title: Web Automation Tools
nodes.description: Tools designed for automating browser interactions, including loading web pages, executing scripts, and handling complex web workflows using services like Browserbase, Hyperbrowser, MultiOn, Selenium, Spider, and Stagehand.

nodes.label: Database Query
nodes.title: Database Query and Search Tools
nodes.description: Tools for querying and performing semantic searches across various database types, including MongoDB, MySQL, SingleStore, Snowflake, Couchbase, Qdrant, Databricks, and general SQL with natural language capabilities (NL2SQL), and AI-Mind for data insights.

nodes.label: File & Content Tools
nodes.title: File and Content Management Tools
nodes.description: Tools for reading, searching, and managing various file formats and directory contents, such as CSV, DOCX, JSON, MDX, PDF, TXT, and XML files, as well as file compression and directory listing.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Tools
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock Integration Tools
nodes.description: Tools specifically designed to interact with AWS Bedrock services, including invoking agents, code interpreters, and knowledge base retrievers, along with browser toolkits.

nodes.label: AI Vision & OCR
nodes.title: AI Vision and OCR Tools
nodes.description: Tools leveraging AI for image analysis, including optical character recognition (OCR) for text extraction and general vision capabilities for describing image content.

nodes.label: Contextual AI Tools
nodes.title: Contextual AI Integration Tools
nodes.description: Tools for integrating with Contextual AI, enabling the creation of RAG agents, parsing documents, and querying these agents for contextual information.

nodes.label: Patronus Evaluation
nodes.title: Patronus Evaluation Tools
nodes.description: Tools for evaluating model inputs and outputs using the Patronus AI platform, offering both general and predefined criteria-based evaluation functionalities.

nodes.label: CrewAI Platform Tools
nodes.title: CrewAI Platform Tools
nodes.description: Tools for integrating with the CrewAI Platform, including generating CrewAI automations and executing platform-defined actions.

nodes.label: Zapier Integration
nodes.title: Zapier Integration Tool
nodes.description: Provides a factory function to generate tools for interacting with various Zapier actions, enabling extensive automation workflows.

nodes.label: GitHub Integration
nodes.title: GitHub Search Tool
nodes.description: A specialized tool for semantic searching within GitHub repositories, including code, issues, and pull requests.

nodes.label: YouTube Integration
nodes.title: YouTube Search Tools
nodes.description: Tools dedicated to semantic searching within YouTube content, covering both individual video content and entire channel uploads.

nodes.label: Composio Integration
nodes.title: Composio Integration Tool
nodes.description: A wrapper for Composio tools, enabling agents to leverage a wide range of third-party integrations and actions.

groups.label: Web Interaction
groups.title: Web Interaction Tools
groups.description: Modules that facilitate interaction with web content, including scraping, searching, and browser automation.

groups.label: Data & Document Processing
groups.title: Data and Document Processing
groups.description: Modules focused on querying diverse data sources and managing various file and document types.

groups.label: AI & Cloud Services
groups.title: AI and Cloud Service Tools
groups.description: Modules integrating with specialized AI models and cloud-specific services, such as AWS Bedrock and Contextual AI.

groups.label: Platform Integrations
groups.title: Platform and External Integrations
groups.description: Modules that provide integration with various external platforms and services, enhancing automation and connectivity.
